name: m11-w5
note: I5, the corpus gold set: 15 aggregation + 5 single-fact + 2 negative instances, both arms in corpus mode over the same funnel, so the contrast is what the loop adds given the built retrieval. This is the in-domain H1 reading; the floor and the direction are pre-registered in Eval D-22 before any answer is read (Evaluation.md §6.2, §9 W5). The arms mirror the W5b host arm so the A2 rows are the same environment the compound wave runs, and W6 joins its ablations to these rows on query_id. The query list below is a three-instance placeholder; the real wave is 22 instances x 2 arms (expect 44), and m11-waves.json carries the placeholder count until experiments/instruments/i5-gold-v1.jsonl exists.

arms.name: a0
arms.note: A0: flat RAG. The same segmentation and the same funnel, one chat call with the chunks inline, stop_reason=flat. No gate and no claim pass, so its grounding is scored offline through the same path as A2.

arms.name: a2
arms.note: A2: the frozen treatment arm (F2+KG, sub reasoning low).
